test_title: PYST 35: SSC MTS 2022 - English (Held On: 18 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**In the following question, out of the given four alternatives, select the alternative which best expresses the meaning of the Idiom/Phrase.**

Bark up the wrong tree

options.text: To invest one’s money in wrong business
To scold someone for the mistake they have not done
To reach at a wrong address
To waste one’s energy or effort by pursuing the wrong thing

solution:
The correct answer is: **To waste one's energy or effort by pursuing the wrong thing.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• **Bark up** the wrong tree is an idiom that means to direct one's efforts towards the wrong person
